decisions: Implement the ability on the existing Gameplay Ability System setup (UShooterAbilitySystemComponent), not as a new component.
Server-authoritative: the ability runs LocalPredicted; damage is applied only on the server through a GameplayEffect.

tasks.description: Create UGA_DashStrike (UShooterGameplayAbility subclass): LocalPredicted dash forward using a root-motion task, server-side sphere sweep at the end of the dash, apply DamageEffectClass to each hit actor once, commit cost and cooldown.
tasks.expected_output: Ability header/source following GA_Sprint conventions; handoff lists every engine API used and whether it was verified.
validation: Damage is applied only when HasAuthority()
No UObject raw pointer members without UPROPERTY
Cooldown and cost committed via CommitAbility

tasks.description: Create UDashStrikeDamageExecution (UGameplayEffectExecutionCalculation) that scales base damage by the source's AttackPower attribute and the target's Armor attribute from UShooterAttributeSet.
tasks.expected_output: Execution calculation class with captured attribute definitions; formula documented in the header.
validation: Uses existing AttackPower/Armor attributes; no new attributes

tasks.description: Grant GA_DashStrike in AShooterCharacter's default abilities and bind it to the existing ability input tag mapping (InputTag.Ability.Secondary).
tasks.expected_output: Ability granted on the server only (in PossessedBy), input tag routed through the existing ASC input path.
validation: GiveAbility is called only with authority

tasks.description: Specify the editor work: GE_DashStrike_Damage (uses UDashStrikeDamageExecution), GE_DashStrike_Cooldown, the dash AnimMontage notify, and the InputAction/IMC entry.
tasks.expected_output: Step-by-step editor instructions with asset paths, parent classes and property values; list of gameplay tags needed.
validation: Every asset referenced by T1/T2 code has a creation step
No instruction requires editing .uasset files outside the editor

tasks.description: Review T1-T3: replication/authority, prediction keys, GC safety of captured pointers, cooldown/cost, convention match.
tasks.expected_output: Structured review report with severity, file:line evidence and a verdict.
validation: Every blocking finding has file:line evidence

tasks.description: Compile ShooterGameEditor Win64 Development and analyse any UBT/compiler errors.
tasks.expected_output: Exact build command, exit code, and root-cause analysis of the first error (or 'build succeeded').
validation: Build command and result quoted verbatim
Only runs when the user requested compilation

tasks.description: Create the assets described by T4 in the Unreal Editor and play-test with two clients (Net Mode: Play as Client).
tasks.expected_output: User confirms the assets exist and the dash damages remote targets once.
validation: PIE with 2 clients: damage appears on both clients, applied once
